Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner with a prayer to direct the opposite party no.4 to refer his application dated 02.06.2023 under section 64(1) of the Rights to Fair Compensation &
Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-Settlement Act, 2013 vide Annexure-3 to the competent authority for determination of just and fair compensation within a stipulated time.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that even though more than a year has been passed since the date of making the application, no step has been taken by the opposite party no.4 and therefore, direction may be issued to the opposite party no.4 to refer the application under Annexure-3 to the competent authority for consideration.

Considering such submissions made and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
this Court directs opposite party no.4-Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lower Suktel Irrigation Project, Bolangir to take a decision on referring the application of the petitioner under Annexure-3 in accordance with law to the competent Authority within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order along with a copy of the writ petition which will be produced by the petitioner and communicate the order of reference to the petitioner within two weeks of making the reference.
The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
